APPROVED_WORK_PACKAGE.ENGINEERING_OBJECTIVE: Build a production-style Go route control plane that models desired route and policy state, reconciles it across a multi-node Linux fleet, detects drift, protects management reachability, records revision history, and exposes the same lifecycle through an operator dashboard and Ansible-driven installation/configuration.

REQUIRED_END_STATE: Canonical IPv4/IPv6 route and policy-rule desired state with stable identities and valid table dependencies.
Preview/apply/rollback are revision-fenced and failure-safe across retries and restart.
Drift detection and reconcile use fresh observations and preserve unowned routing objects.
Fleet rollouts isolate failed canaries/offline nodes and do not reapply nodes already at the target revision.
Ansible deployment converges idempotently while preserving host-specific protected routing over defaults.
Dashboard mutations are bound to the exact preview revision and cannot silently overwrite newer operator changes.
Existing public Go API/runtime surfaces remain available and all mutations stay inside the deterministic isolated routing model.
